question: In K-means Clustering, the number of clusters to be formed is denoted by the parameter ________.
The ________ is a measure used in K-means Clustering to calculate the similarity between a data point and a cluster centroid.
K-means Clustering can be applied to which type(s) of data?
The centroid in K-means Clustering represents __________.

answers.a: The average of all data points in a cluster
answers.b: The data point farthest from all other data points
answers.c: The data point closest to all other data points
answers.d: The median of all data points in a cluster

answers.b: Assigning all data points to their closest centroids
answers.c: Calculating the average distance between data points and centroids
